senses.zh_definition: 待辨识的书写形式 xing；现有资料不足以确定其词义，本文仅将它作为被引用的字串处理。
senses.en_definition: The unidentified written form xing, treated here only as a quoted string; no Malay lexical meaning has been established.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk tulisan xing yang belum dikenal pasti maknanya; digunakan di sini hanya sebagai rentetan aksara yang dipetik.
senses.nuances: 此项是元语言说明，不是已核实的马来语词义；noun 仅描述引用字串时的名词性用法。若来源为汉语拼音，缺少声调、汉字和上下文便不能确定意义，例如 xīng 可对应“星”，xìng 可对应“姓”。参见[教育部国语小字典：星](https://dict.mini.moe.edu.tw/SearchIndex/word_detail?breadcrumbs=Search_%E6%98%9F_one&dictSearchField=%E6%98%9F&wordID=D0003433)及[教育部重编国语辞典：姓](https://dict.revised.moe.edu.tw/dictView.jsp?ID=7270&la=1&powerMode=0)。以下组合仅示范如何讨论该字串，不冒充高频词汇搭配。

dual_scenarios.en: Additional context is needed to determine the meaning and pronunciation of the written form "xing".

etymology.historical_story: No defensible word history can be assigned to this isolated spelling. If it represents Mandarin pinyin, tone and character identity matter: xīng can represent 星, while xìng can represent 姓. Those are different words, not interchangeable meanings of a Malay headword. The original sentence or naming context is therefore needed before an etymology can be established. [MOE dictionary: 姓](https://dict.revised.moe.edu.tw/dictView.jsp?ID=7270&la=1&powerMode=0)
